name: Control Panel / Sheet
description: Canonical compact control panel sheet, 390 × 178 reference. Cargo uses this composition responsively below 1024px; no separate landscape variant. Interaction targets remain at least 44px while visible artwork follows the component's optical sizing.

name: Control Panel
description: Canonical expanded control panel. Reference geometry: 200 × 232 at Desktop/1440. Cargo scales the complete panel to about 142 × 209 at 1024 and 250 × 290 from 1800 upward. Fine pointers use optical 20/24/32/36px rows; coarse pointers retain 44px hit targets. Panel typography always follows the breakpoint Medium caption scale.

name: Image Shape
description: Shape picker row: 3 Image Shape Option instances (optical sizes). Total 168 = panel content width. Selection = swap State prop.

name: Nav
description: Left rail: wordmark + page links + contact links. Web: plain <a> list, no <nav> styling.

name: Nav
description: Left rail: wordmark + page links + contact links. Web: plain <a> list, no <nav> styling.

name: Swatch
description: Color picker dot. Selected = small center dot (radio-button semantics): white dot on colored swatches, black dot on the White swatch. Web: <input type=radio> restyled.

name: Image Shape Option
description: Image display-shape picker option. Uniform 36-tall cells (control-row height); optical correction via per-variant INSETS: straight 2, rounded 1, oval 0 -&gt; shapes 32/34/36. Insets are constraint-preserved, so hierarchy survives FILL at any width. Default = bg + 0.75px border + ink glyph; Selected = inverted.

name: Link
description: Browser-default anchor. Web: <a> — #0000EE underlined, visited #551A8B. Hover changes nothing (cursor only), true to default HTML.

name: Timestamp
description: Live 24-hour timestamp. Color is bound to semantic text/primary so the clock follows the active theme on desktop and compact layouts.

name: Buttons
description: HTML-honest states: Default; Selected = inverted black fill (aria-pressed / picker chosen); Focus = 1px dotted rectangular outline offset 3 (:focus-visible); Disabled = muted (:disabled). NO hover (raw HTML has none), no transitions. Pickers show content glyphs (e.g. Image Icon) — selection = inversion, not checkmarks.

name: Shape=Rectangle, State=Default
description: Straight-angle button. 1px border/default, no radius, Small label. Web: <button> with all default styling stripped except 1px solid border.

name: Shape=Rectangle, State=Selected
description: Straight-angle button. 1px border/default, no radius, Small label. Web: <button> with all default styling stripped except 1px solid border.

name: Shape=Rectangle, State=Focus
description: Straight-angle button. 1px border/default, no radius, Small label. Web: <button> with all default styling stripped except 1px solid border.

name: Shape=Rectangle, State=Disabled
description: Straight-angle button. 1px border/default, no radius, Small label. Web: <button> with all default styling stripped except 1px solid border.

name: Slider
description: Type-scale slider with Compact and Expanded contexts. Four discrete steps map to device-specific Type Scale modes. Compact endpoints are 17–30; Expanded endpoints are 18–36. Endpoint glyphs retain 4 px internal padding and the 24 px optical row sits inside a 44 px web touch target.

name: Context=Expanded, Scale=Medium
description: Type-size slider: a (14) — 1px track with 12px thumb — a (18). Track-area FILLs, thumb stays center-constrained, labels hug. Set instances to FILL width. Web: <input type=range> restyled: 1px track, round black thumb, no focus ring removal.

name: Context=Expanded, Scale=Small
description: Type-size slider: a (14) — 1px track with 12px thumb — a (18). Track-area FILLs, thumb stays center-constrained, labels hug. Set instances to FILL width. Web: <input type=range> restyled: 1px track, round black thumb, no focus ring removal.

description: Type-size slider: a (14) — 1px track with 12px thumb — a (18). Track-area FILLs, thumb stays center-constrained, labels hug. Set instances to FILL width. Web: <input type=range> restyled: 1px track, round black thumb, no focus ring removal.

name: Control Icon
description: Opens the Control Panel sheet on mobile. Mixer glyph: 2px rails + 8px knobs (echoes the Slider). Sits left of Timestamp. Web: <button aria-label="controls" aria-expanded> — give it >=44px tap padding in CSS.

name: Open Icon
description: Open Icon: 24px plus with two theme-ink strokes. Opens the compact Control Panel from a 44px web target. When expanded, swap to Close Icon / Pressed.

name: Image Icon
description: Image-placeholder pictogram (mountains + sun) for the Image Shape picker. Filled vector, no outer frame — the button shape provides the frame. Recolor fills white on inverted/selected buttons.

name: Property 1=Default
description: Cross to dismiss the Control Panel sheet. Two 2px diagonal strokes, flat caps, 16px span. Web: <button aria-label="close"> — pair with >=44px tap padding.

name: Property 1=Pressed
description: Pressed Close Icon: square fill uses semantic text/primary; X stroke uses semantic bg/page. This is the active mobile panel toggle and closes the sheet. Web pressed/focus state uses the same semantic tokens.

name: Image Frame
description: THE image asset. Place an instance, override the img layer fill with the photo, size freely — proportions live on the instance, the SHAPE follows the ui image/shape variable (bind Shape prop per instance; duplicating a bound instance carries the binding). Straight = rect · Rounded = radius/image token (24) · Oval = TRUE ellipse stretched non-uniformly (per Ocean: a circle stretched to frame the image). Fill overrides survive variant switches via the same-named img layer.

name: Project Description
description: Showcase description block. Props: title/tagline/blurb/url (TEXT), hasUrl (BOOLEAN — hides the url line for unlinked projects). White fill + 16 top seam + col/6 width baked in. url = underlined text (swap to a Link instance post-TNR-flip if wanted). Restyle master texts once in UI (Body / Caption Italic / Body / Body+underline); instances inherit.

name: Write Passage
description: Showcase description block. Props: title/tagline/blurb/url (TEXT), hasUrl (BOOLEAN — hides the url line for unlinked projects). Restyle master texts once in UI (Body / Caption Italic / Body / Body+underline); instances inherit.
